answer: Emission per identity starts as a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 18 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 507 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The falcon of the design is public, the juniper of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the thread of honest work is what finally pays.
